body.message:
We can extend your booking directly with us for an additional 1 month (30 nights), and the extension rate will be AED 16,000.

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 will also be required. The deposit is fully refundable upon check-out, provided there are no damages to the apartment. The refund will be processed within 7 working days after your departure.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed with the extension, and we will be happy to assist you.
